Presenter on the board: a NEW confident WOMAN about 30, modern, worldly and likeable (not a fashion model), waist-up, her clothes in the palette colours, a studio backdrop in the palette colours. The SAME woman appears in all frames. All text short and correctly spelled. Mood: sunny, global, travel-energy, optimistic. Palette «Солнце и бирюза»: sunny yellow #FFC83D background, deep teal #0F5257 headlines, coral #FF6B57 highlights, white cards. Typography: «Unbounded» bold headlines + «Inter». The woman has dark curly shoulder-length hair and wears a deep teal blouse.
